Classificação  de  Gêneros  Musicais  Utilizando  Técnicas  de  
Machine
 
Learning
 
 
Victor  Castelo  Branco  Brasileiro  Pereira   
1
Curso  de  Sistemas  da  Informação(SI)  –  Universidade  Tiradentes(UNIT)  
Aracaju
 
-
 
SE
 
Brazil
 
 
Abstract.  This  paper  presents  the  replication  of  a  methodology  for  musical  
genre
 
classification
 
using
 
machine
 
learning
 
techniques.
 
The
 
GTZAN
 
dataset
 
was
 
used,
 
which
 
contains
 
audio
 
samples
 
from
 
different
 
musical
 
genres.
 
The
 
approach
 
involves
 
feature
 
extraction
 
using
 
Mel
 
Frequency
 
Cepstral
 
Coefficients
 
(MFCC)
 
and
 
the
 
application
 
of
 
supervised
 
learning
 
algorithms
 
such
 
as
 
K-Nearest
 
Neighbors
 
and
 
Random
 
Forest.
 
The
 
results
 
show
 
that
 
the
 
models
 
are
 
able
 
to
 
identify
 
relevant
 
patterns
 
in
 
the
 
data,
 
achieving
 
satisfactory
 
accuracy,
 
with
 
Random
 
Forest
 
presenting
 
the
 
best
 
performance.
 
 
Resumo.  A  classificação  automática  de  gêneros  musicais  tem  se  tornado  uma  
tarefa
 
relevante
 
no
 
contexto
 
atual,
 
especialmente
 
devido
 
ao
 
crescimento
 
de
 
plataformas
 
digitais
 
de
 
streaming.
